shortening: successive floor(length/2) suffixes; accept while greedy equals original greedy; stop at first mismatch or length 1
position_policy: each shortened suffix starts at position zero; no artificial BOS or padding
score: negative weighted mean Jensen-Shannon divergence between Bernoulli(original_true_probability) and Bernoulli(original_greedy_probability)
probability_computation: FP32 log_softmax; cached log probabilities; FP64 probability/divergence/weight reduction
comparison_policy: same length only, deduplicated exact token prefixes; no padding or cross-prefix KV reuse
head_projection: fixed one-row LM head; lossless native float16 terminal cache
